description: Upload a pause thumbnail — an image shown when the viewer pauses the video. Provide `image_url` pointing to a publicly reachable JPG, PNG or GIF up to 5 MB. The upload also creates the pause CTA, so the image shows in the player right away, for the whole video. A video can have several pause thumbnails. Returns {response: {pauseThumbnail: [<thumb_name>]}} — keep that name: panda_delete_thumbnail needs it to remove this image. Time window and button overlay are edited in the dashboard pause-thumbnail editor.

image_url.description: Public URL of the image to upload

name: panda_add_pause_thumbnail
title: Add Pause Thumbnail
